title: Policy-pack execution path: channels, shared write path, jobs, pack library

checks.what: Every kind's create/update/delete binds to the SDK 1.11.3 method signature (autospec)
Every rule payload key is a field of the SDK model for that rule type
SaaS rule types equal the SDK's; monitor vs enforcing actions per channel (oracle)
Transient refusals back off linearly up to MAX_ATTEMPTS
A 429 is honoured (reset timer bounded; outside a run waits or reports)
A POST is never resent blindly after a timeout
403 wait-and-retry only for ZIA (ZPA, AI Guard, outside a run: once)
Cancel and stop-before-start race-free; ending claimed once
Finished job store and pending stops capped
Logs bounded per line and in total, cursor survives the cut, secrets masked
Upload size cap, ZIP member caps, NaN/Infinity refused
Type confusion and nesting in uploads refused in words
Pack ids, ZIP member names and delete targets cannot leave the library; symlinks not followed
HCL reader and provenance strip linear on hostile input
Ids in raw request paths are whole numbers
Bundle round-trip, older endpoint_application_groups key, escapes and provenance strip unchanged

findings.title: Exponential ReDoS in the Terraform string token: an unterminated "$${$${... pins a worker thread
findings.fix: String token reduced to the equivalent unambiguous (\\.|[^"\\])*; the $${ / %%{ alternatives were subsumed and ambiguous

findings.title: Quadratic provenance strip on a Terraform description with long runs of spaces or brackets
findings.fix: Only the last 400 characters (where the tag lives) are searched

findings.title: Pack upload with a field of the wrong JSON type crashed validation (HTTP 500 on preview; ~1,500 fuzz-found inputs)
findings.fix: Shape check of every dictionary, engine, rule, sub-rule and app group in assemble_pack; refused in words

findings.title: Uploaded JSON nesting was not capped
findings.fix: MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 32, walked without recursion

findings.title: Non-text upload content was passed to bytes(), which allocates an integer's worth of memory
findings.fix: Content must be text; base64 decoded with validate=True

findings.title: Terraform proximity / dict_template_id of the wrong type raised TypeError
findings.fix: _tf_int() refuses anything but a whole number, in words

findings.title: A malformed Zscaler API export crashed native conversion with TypeError
findings.fix: convert_parts wrapped at the pack_library boundary: refused in words

findings.title: Job log cursor stalled once the log reached MAX_LOG_LINES: every later line (Stop, the result) was lost to the poller
findings.fix: Job.dropped counts lines cut from the top; `next` and `since` count every line ever written

findings.title: One job log line was unbounded
findings.fix: MAX_LOG_LINE_CHARS = 4000

findings.title: Secrets written as key=value / "key": "value" were not masked in job logs (only token shapes were)
findings.fix: redact_line masks client secret, password, API key, private key and provisioning key pairs

findings.title: Race between a job's own ending and self-heal's abandon: two job_finished entries and a status flipping FAILED -> DONE
findings.fix: The first ending claims Job.ending under the job lock; the other is audited apart

findings.title: prune() could drop a job whose finish time was set but whose final status was not yet published
findings.fix: Only jobs with a final status are pruned

findings.title: Retry-After / x-ratelimit-reset of inf or 1e12 became an unbounded hold of the whole run
findings.fix: A reset timer is trusted only when finite and at most 3600 s

findings.title: Outside a run a 429 was retried after 1 s, ignoring ZIA's reset timer
findings.fix: Short reset honoured (wait = max(backoff, reset)); a long one reported at once

findings.title: An id such as 15030 in a refusal was read as a 503 and retried
findings.fix: Status codes matched as whole numbers only

findings.title: call()'s default op 'write' (a POST) was resent blindly after a timeout
findings.fix: 'write' is treated as a create: resent only after a read by name shows it absent

findings.title: SDK exception text (which may echo the Authorization header) reached outcomes, results and records unredacted
findings.fix: tenant_auth.redact_tokens on the exception text in call()

findings.title: Ids from plans and records were put into raw request paths unchecked ('1/../../status' changes the endpoint of a DELETE/PUT/POST)
findings.fix: pc.path_id(): only a whole number goes into a raw path; otherwise nothing is sent

findings.title: delete() with an unknown channel or no id raised KeyError (no audit entry, a 500 in the caller)
findings.fix: Plain failed Outcome, still audited

findings.title: is_enforcing() failed open: an unknown or lower-case action ("block", "QUARANTINE") was shipped as written instead of monitor-only
findings.fix: Deny by default: only the channel's monitor actions monitor; web payload guarded too

findings.title: SaaS Security API rule payload carried notification_template, not a field of the SDK 1.11.3 CasbdDlpRules model
findings.fix: Not sent (nor resolved) for SaaS rules

findings.title: raw_request / raw_get returned executor errors unredacted
findings.fix: _raw_error() redacts tokens and bounds the text

findings.title: Endpoint application group body sends 'resources' and 'channel'; the SDK 1.11.3 model names end_point_applications (raw request; wire field assumed from a live tenant, not verifiable here)
findings.fix: Left as is: changing the wire format without a tenant could break a working deploy; verify on a lab tenant

findings.title: Running jobs are not capped (only finished ones: MAX_FINISHED_JOBS); write runs are one per tenant (tenant_run)
findings.fix: Single-user local tool; write runs serialised per tenant

findings.title: dlp_importer.build_policy_payload keeps an unknown web action (defence in depth; its only caller, pack_channels.build_payload, now forces monitor)
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (migration QA, 016cf21): build_policy_payload always sends ALLOW, whatever action the pack names

findings.title: tools/quality_score.py rejects the wave-6 findings format: unknown keys 'files', 'coverage' and 'proposed_patch'
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (bde03b1: files, coverage, notes, baseline, proposed_patch keys); completed here: multi-line patches, coverage context, finding files, commit lists
